screenings_recorded.label: Screenings recorded
screenings_recorded.description: Submitted screenings in the period (drafts excluded).

distinct_patients_screened.label: People screened
distinct_patients_screened.description: Distinct patients with at least one submitted screening.

screenings_flagged.label: Screenings flagged
screenings_flagged.description: Submitted screenings the demo rule flagged for clinician review.

reviews_pending.label: Reviews pending
reviews_pending.description: Flagged screenings whose review is pending or in progress.

reviews_completed.label: Reviews completed
reviews_completed.description: Flagged screenings with a recorded decision or a dismissal with reason.

reviews_dismissed.label: Flags dismissed with reason
reviews_dismissed.description: Reviewed flags dismissed by a clinician with a recorded reason. Never counted as completed care.

pathway_referred.label: Referred or follow-up planned
pathway_referred.description: Reviewed flags with an active referral or a planned follow-up.

pathway_completed.label: Pathway completed
pathway_completed.description: Referred screenings with a referral completed with evidence or a follow-up completed with outcome and evidence.

follow_ups_completed.label: Follow-ups completed
follow_ups_completed.description: Follow-ups completed with a recorded outcome.

median_days_to_review.label: Median days to review
median_days_to_review.description: Median days from measurement to review decision, rounded to 1 decimal.

overdue_referrals.label: Referrals past due date
overdue_referrals.description: Open referrals whose demo due date has passed.

overdue_follow_ups.label: Follow-ups past due date
overdue_follow_ups.description: Open follow-ups whose demo due date has passed.

missing_glucose_unit.label: Missing glucose unit
missing_glucose_unit.description: Submitted screenings with a glucose value but no unit.

possible_duplicate_identities.label: Possible duplicate identities
possible_duplicate_identities.description: Patients marked as a possible duplicate.

flags_overturned_at_review.label: Flags overturned at review
flags_overturned_at_review.description: Flags a clinician dismissed after review.

staff_time_minutes.label: Staff-time proxy (demo)
staff_time_minutes.description: Contact-attempt minutes plus screening capture time, in minutes. A demo proxy, not a measured workload.

metric.staffTimeProxyNote: Staff-time proxy (demo) — not a measured workload.
